findings.title: Independent QA test remains incomplete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 states that an unavailable or inconclusive check is not PASS.
findings.trigger: The exact v5 report is assessed before a witnessed independent verification exists.
findings.consequence: Prompt Test 8 and the checkpoint completion gate remain unsatisfied.
findings.evidence: Test 8 states “In progress.” The execution journal ends with ACT-022 started and result pending; no witnessed `QA_PASSED` verification identifies v5.

findings.title: Ownership evidence contradicts Test 1’s required result
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires a supported PASS conclusion; criterion 4 forbids borrowing another prompt’s mutation authority.
findings.trigger: P03’s amended paths are compared with every other active prompt as Test 1 requires.
findings.consequence: Test 1 cannot pass because mutation units are shared rather than owned exactly once.
findings.evidence: V5’s scan reports three literal overlaps: P01 on `tests/refactor_repo/test_packaging_skeleton.py`, P04 on `src/curriculum_factory/`, and P09 on `tests/runtime/`. The prompt’s expected result says no unit may be “shared” or “borrowed from a successor”; it provides no sequential or textual-ceiling exception. The report’s explanation does not satisfy that literal expected result.

findings.title: The required pre-move dry-run reconciliation was never recorded
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 3 requires the exact procedure and evidence for every prompt test; criterion 4 requires prerequisites and stop conditions to be demonstrated.
findings.trigger: Test 2 is checked for the required comparison before the first source move.
findings.consequence: The checkpoint cannot prove candidate coverage reconciled before mutation or that the associated stop condition was honored.
findings.evidence: V5 runs a dry-run only against the already-moved final tree and obtains zero candidates. That is a post-change idempotency check, not the prompt-required comparison of P02 live dry-run candidates with the current AST inventory before the first move. Referring generally to P02’s earlier checkpoint does not record P03’s required pre-move reconciliation.

findings.title: The current checkpoint path ledger is descriptive rather than complete
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 2 requires every changed, created, moved, and deleted path; criterion 6 requires the post-change git status.
findings.trigger: The uncommitted documentation and QA delta associated with v5 is audited.
findings.consequence: Reviewers cannot determine the exact complete current delta or prove authorization for every individual path from the report.
findings.evidence: Section 2 acknowledges a non-empty working tree but summarizes it by directories and filename classes rather than including or preserving the literal final `git status --porcelain`. The actual status includes numerous individual v4/v5, QA-round, evidence, journal, and t3 paths not enumerated in the 223-path code-commit ledger.

findings.title: Current documentation deliverables still lack immutable digest coverage
findings.criterion_ref: Criterion 6 requires a reviewable diff or immutable digest for every deliverable.
findings.trigger: V5 and the uncommitted QA/evidence files are treated as checkpoint deliverables.
findings.consequence: The exact report and supporting evidence being judged cannot be authenticated as a complete immutable set.
findings.evidence: V5 expressly says the checkpoint-documentation commit “has not yet been made” and will be created only after this round. The commit ledger covers `ee8922a`, not the current v5 report, round-4/5 QA files, test evidence, deprecated reports, journal changes, or t3 logs. A future planned commit is not present evidence.

observations: The post-commit regression comparison remains materially improved: exactly the 29 amended P04 allowlist IDs are new relative to t0.
V5 correctly retracts v4’s false clean-worktree and committed-evidence claims.
The no-mutation preflight and file-mode evidence address those specific omissions from round 4.
V5 no longer claims the overall checkpoint process is complete before independent QA.
reasoning: The disk history accurately records all four verdicts I previously issued. Although the substantive regression set is now confined to the amended P04 allowlist, the artifact’s own ownership scan contradicts Test 1, the required pre-move reconciliation remains absent, and the current documentation delta is neither fully enumerated nor immutably covered. Test 8 is also explicitly pending.
